motion: The camera does not move. The small grey delivery robot sits alone among the empty chairs, facing the camera the whole time, the torn cloth bunting hanging across its front wheels the whole time. Its amber beacon pulses once. It rolls forward a short way and stops, then edges a few centimetres to one side and back, as if looking for someone. It waits. Nothing else moves. The pools of light under the chairs stay on. The camera does not move.
